paragraphs: R' Shimon ben Elyakim; another text, ben Yakim: Nedarim 39a. R' Abba came before R' Avahu, R' Hanina bar Pappi, R' Yitzhak Nappaha, and R' Ila. They sent him to R' Shimon ben Elyakim and R' Elazar ben Pedat; see his entry. He called R' Elazar “my teacher”: Ketubbot 50b. R' Elazar told him, “Do not ask me in the study hall to embarrass me”: Bava Batra 81b. He objected to R' Elazar: Bekhorot 56a. In R' Elazar ben Pedat's name, who said in R' Elazar ben Shammua's name: Hullin 7a; Zevahim 65, end of side b. He said to R' Elazar, “Explain it to me”: Zevahim 118b, according to Rashi's reading; see what I wrote about this in the rules. He and R' Elazar brought an incident before R' Yohanan: Jerusalem Kiddushin 1:3. He asked R' Yohanan: Orlah, beginning of chapter 1. R' Yonatan was raising an objection. R' Yose bar Hanina said to him, “Here is R' Shimon ben Yakim.” He intended only to elevate him, since he was a great man: Jerusalem Sanhedrin, end of chapter 6, halakhah 10. R' Shimon ben Elyakim sought to have R' Yose bar Hanina ordained; see his entry. And R' Mani bar Pattish and Resh Lakish. He objected to Resh Lakish, who told him, “May your hour raise you”—meaning, may your fortune rise: Avodah Zarah 34b.
